content: The execution was successful (Reward 1.0). The Executor correctly handled the critical HWPX challenge: placeholders ({{...}}) being fragmented across multiple <hp:t> tags. The strategy of concatenating all text within a paragraph (<hp:p>), performing substitution, and then re-injecting the result into the first <hp:t> while clearing others proved effective. This approach, combined with clearing <hp:lineSegArray> to reset the layout cache, ensures a valid and rendered HWPX output. The packaging step correctly prioritized the 'mimetype' file as uncompressed (ZIP_STORED) to meet OCF standards.
